common.tagline: Your karaoke, in a fair queue

landing.title: Sing in turn, no fighting over the mic
landing.subtitle: Scan the QR code on your table, pick a song, and the app orders the queue fairly between tables.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Choose how to continue
login.guestHint: Just here to sing? Guests don't need an account.

errors.invalidPhone: Enter a valid Israeli number, e.g. 050-123-4567
errors.invalidCode: That code is wrong or has expired
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

join.title: Join your table
join.subtitle: Scan the QR code on your table, or type the code printed next to it.
join.namePlaceholder: The name shown in the queue
join.nameHint: Just tell us what to call you.

errors.invalidCode: The code is 4–8 letters and digits

tokenNotFound.title: This QR code is no longer active
tokenNotFound.body: You can type the table code instead.

status.open: The night is on! Pick a song from the catalog below and tap Request.

status.gone: This table is no longer active. Scan a new QR code or ask the staff for a code.
status.unknown: We couldn't check the night status. We'll try again on the next refresh.

errors.notParticipant: You're not at a table in tonight's queue. Rejoin your table and try again.
errors.invalidInput: Check the song and the singers' names.
errors.unavailable: The request didn't reach the server. Try again in a moment.

dj.title: DJ console
dj.demoHint: Supabase isn't configured, so changes stay in this browser.

night.confirmClose: Close the night? {count} waiting requests will be skipped.
night.closedBody: Open a night so guests can request songs. The queue, player and mixer wake up with it.

notStaff.title: You're not on any venue's staff
notStaff.body: Ask the venue owner to add you as a DJ, then reload this page.

unavailable.title: We couldn't load the queue
unavailable.body: Check the connection and try again.

errors.unavailable: The change didn't reach the server. The queue was reloaded.
errors.staleNight: The night changed. The queue was reloaded.
errors.notStaff: You're no longer staff at this venue.

queue.title: Queue
queue.nothingSingingHint: Press Start on the next song when the singer is ready.
queue.empty: The queue is empty. Guest requests show up here within seconds.
queue.pinnedHint: This song stays in this place; the fair order arranges the others around it. Use the pin button to give it back to the fair order.
queue.autoStart: Auto-start the next song after Done

drag.instructions: To pick up a song, press Space or Enter. Use the up and down arrows to move it, Space or Enter to drop it, Escape to cancel.
drag.dropped: {title} dropped at place {place} and stays there.

player.title: Player
player.error: YouTube couldn't play this version. Try another one.
player.emptyHint: Start a song from the queue, or wait for the next request.
player.noVideos: No karaoke video is linked to this song. Load it in VirtualDJ.
player.noEmbeddable: This song's versions can't play inside the app. Open one on YouTube or load it in VirtualDJ.

mixer.title: Mixer
mixer.micDenied: Microphone access was denied. Allow it in the browser's site settings.
mixer.micUnsupported: This browser can't route the microphone.
mixer.micHint: The mic plays through the default speakers via the browser; the venue's hardware mixer keeps driving the PA.
mixer.masterHint: Cuts music and mic together. Use it between songs or when the host talks.

admin.demoHint: Supabase isn't configured, so changes stay in this browser for a few hours.

notStaff.body: Ask the venue owner to add you as an admin, then reload this page.

notAdmin.title: You're a DJ here, not an admin
notAdmin.body: Tables, the QR sheet and the rules are managed by the venue's owner or admin. Ask them to promote you if you need access.

unavailable.title: We couldn't load the venue
unavailable.body: Check the connection and try again.

overview.title: Overview
overview.tables: {total, plural, =0 {No tables yet} one {# table} other {# tables}}, {active, plural, =0 {none active} one {# active} other {# active}}
overview.djHint: Run the night here: queue with drag and drop, player and mixer. Hover a table name to see who sits there and when its turn comes. Music keeps playing while you move between admin tabs.

tonight.title: Tables tonight
tonight.hint: Who sits at each table, since when, what they are waiting for and what they sang. Updates on its own.
tonight.summary: {openTables, plural, =0 {No open tables} one {# open table} other {# open tables}} · {guests, plural, =0 {no guests} one {# guest} other {# guests}} · {waiting, plural, =0 {nothing waiting} one {# song waiting} other {# songs waiting}} · {sung, plural, =0 {nothing sung yet} one {# sung} other {# sung}}

tables.hint: Each table has a QR code and a short typed code. Deactivated tables keep their history but guests can't join them.

settings.title: Settings

rules.title: Queue rules
rules.hint: Rules apply to the next night you open; a night that is already running keeps the rules it started with.
rules.fairnessHint: How the queue alternates between tables or singers.
rules.maxSingersPerSongHint: At least 1. Only matters when duets are allowed.
rules.nightCutoffMinutesBeforeCloseHint: Leave empty to accept requests until the night closes.
rules.requireHostApprovalHint: New requests wait for the DJ before they enter the queue.
rules.allowDuetsHint: More than one singer on a request.
rules.hostPriorityEnabledHint: A higher priority sorts a request earlier.

settings.saved: Saved. The next night you open uses these rules.
settings.savedDemo: Saved in this browser's demo venue.

errors.nameRequired: Enter a venue name (up to 80 characters).
errors.notAdmin: Only the venue's owner or admin can change settings.
errors.unavailable: The settings didn't reach the server. Try again in a moment.
